title: Preserve persistence write failures when staging cleanup also fails
description: ROBUSTNESS review: exception handlers in FileKeyStore._write_slot, TrustStorePersistence._write_json_locked, TwoSlotFilePersistence._write_slot, and _ensure_tx_marker call Path.unlink during an active write/replace failure without suppressing cleanup errors. A concurrent removal, permissions fault, or injected unlink error can mask the actionable primary fsync/replace/chmod failure (and for trust obscure indeterminate transition classification). Make cleanup best-effort without replacing the original exception and add focused fault tests.
